title: The chosen strict identity compact-support tower is reduction
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], let $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, let $\ell$ be a prime which is a unit in $k$, and let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite with its specified valuation ring and finite quotients. Let $A$ be a coefficient derived-system calculus [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus] over $s$. Let $T_0$ and $(e_{0,n})_n$ be exactly the tower and evaluation isomorphisms chosen in [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor] for the identity compactification $(\mathrm{id}_s,\mathrm{id}_s)$. Then there are a tower functor $T$, evaluation isomorphisms $e_n:T\operatorname{ev}_n\cong R_{!,n}^{\mathrm{id}}$, and an isomorphism of functors $\theta:U_s A.\mathcal R\cong T$, with $T=T_0$ and $e=e_0$ after transport. The canonical finite identity comparison $d_n$ is formed by the sectionwise identity extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero] followed by the normalized identity derived direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image], and scalar restriction. For every ambient derived object $C$, $\operatorname{ev}_n(\theta_C)e_{n,C}d_{n,C}$ is the restricted evaluation comparison followed by scalar restriction of $A.\mathrm{reductionEvaluation}_{n,C}$. For all $m\ge n$ the maps $e_n$ intertwine the actual tower transitions with compactSupportRestrictedTransition, including the specified restriction-of-scalars comparison [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars].

proof.text: Use the whole-system identity open and identity proper-image comparisons, not a lift of levelwise derived maps. Compare the reduction adjunction used by the tower with A by uniqueness of its left adjoint. Whisker with exact restriction to construct theta. The unit-projection normalization fixes the evaluation square to the canonical finite identity composite.

theorem identityReductionTower (hk : IsUnit (l : D.k))
    (A : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E (point D)) :
    ∃ (T : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E (point D)) ⥤
        coefficientSequenceRestrictedDerived l E (point D))
      (e : ∀ n : ℕ, T ⋙ coefficientConstantTowerEvaluation l E (point D) n ≅
        compactSupportRestrictedLevel l E (Compactification.ofIsProper (𝟙 (point D))) n)
      (θ : A.reduction ⋙ coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction l E (point D) ≅ T),
      T = Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (exists_compactSupportReductionTower l E D.k (point D) (point D)
          (𝟙 (point D)) hk
          (Compactification.ofIsProper (𝟙 (point D)))))).2.2 ∧
      HEq e (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
          (exists_compactSupportReductionTower l E D.k (point D) (point D)
            (𝟙 (point D)) hk
            (Compactification.ofIsProper (𝟙 (point D)))))).2.2).2).2) ∧
      (∀ (C : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E (point D))) (n : ℕ),
        (coefficientConstantTowerEvaluation l E (point D) n).map (θ.hom.app C) ≫
            (e n).hom.app C ≫ (finiteRestrictedIdentity D l E n).hom.app C =
          (coefficientRestrictedEvaluationIso l E (point D) n).hom.app
              (A.reduction.obj C) ≫
            (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E (point D) n).map
              ((A.reductionEvaluation n).hom.app C)) ∧
      ∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m)
        (C : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E (point D))),
        (pbcTowerTransition (point D)
            (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E (point D)) m n h).app
              (T.obj C) ≫ (e n).hom.app C =
          (e m).hom.app C ≫ compactSupportRestrictedTransition l E
            (Compactification.ofIsProper (𝟙 (point D))) m n h C
